'''2010 Yavin 4 Regionals Tim Simon DS Tatooine Occupation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Tim Simon]] at [[2010 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine Occupation|SE-D-tatooineoccupation.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' I Do What I Want
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
